text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A while ago, a kid I know asked me to
fix up their
ripped stuffed animal.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I did, and when I handed it back to
them, they
gave me this big smile and
called me the "Plushie
Doctor."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you can tell, but stuffed animals
aren't
exactly my thing. But I don't
know, after seeing
that smile...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. I guess being a "Plushie Doctor"
wouldn't
be so bad.
